content:
maria: Quick sync — we need a tight checklist for entitlements + packaging across AWS/GCP/Azure so we can hit the go-to-market milestone next week. Primary asks: SKU mapping, legal artifacts, billing/metering model, and minimal technical artifacts (AMI/container). Who owns what?

jin: I can take the legal artifacts (reseller terms, contract addendum, SOC attestation copies). Need the SKU table and the customer's expected pricing tiers to draft the right clauses. @maria please confirm if we require marketplace-specific indemnities.

sam: Packaging/product here — we have 3 tiers (dev, standard, enterprise). For marketplace catalogs we need: SKU id, display name, short description (<= 120 chars), allowed regions, trial flag, and whether metering is required. Also mapping for free trial duration.

leo: Engineering notes: for AWS we must provide either AMI or container image + launch instruction. GCP wants container + marketplace listing descriptor. Azure requires VM image or managed app manifest. Also: BYOL support and license key flow (we'll need an endpoint for license validation).

rachel: Sales asks: can we show monthly pricing vs commit pricing? Some partners expect MSRP and marketplace list price. Need pricing guidance by tomorrow so sellers can quote. Also any marketplace revenue share to include in deal desk?

maria: Good — propose owners: jin=legal artifacts, sam=sku table + descriptions, leo=technical artifacts (images/manifests + lic validation), rachel=pricing/ramp plan. I'll coordinate submission windows and AMI/manifest uploads.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS listing preflight checks run nightly. Next run: 1903459900 UTC. Artifacts required: product-README, architecture diagram, support contacts.

sam: Putting together SKU table now. Draft snippet (will drop full CSV in drive):

```
SKU,DisplayName,Tier,TrialAllowed,Regions,Metering
RDW-D-1,Redwood Dedicated - Dev,dev,yes,us-west-2|us-east-1,no
RDW-S-1,Redwood Dedicated - Standard,standard,yes,us-west-2|eu-west-1,yes
RDW-E-1,Redwood Dedicated - Enterprise,enterprise,no,global,yes
```

jin: For legal, add a section for data residency guarantees per region. If customer selects EU-only, we need the certs in the package. Also include support SLA for marketplace vs direct contracts.

leo: FYI on technical: we need a small README snippet for launch instructions and a license-check endpoint example. I can mock an endpoint at /license/validate that returns 200/403. Example payload: `{"sku":"RDW-S-1","license_key":"xxxx"}`.

maria: Action items and owners quick list:
- jin: draft contract addendum + required cert checklist (due: 1903480000)
- sam: final SKU CSV + short descriptions + 120-char blurbs (due: 1903468000)
- leo: AMI/container artifacts uploaded to staging + license endpoint stub (due: 1903472000)
- rachel: pricing matrix (list vs commit) + revenue share notes (due: 1903464000)

rachel: One more — marketing wants a one-liner and 3 bullet benefits for the marketplace page. I'll follow up after I see the blurb.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, ping me and I'll escalate to partnerships/legal ops. Meeting to confirm final package: Thu 09:30 PT. :calendar: 

jin: :thumbsup: will start legal draft tonight.

leo: will spin up the AMI pipeline and post image IDs in the thread when ready.

sam: uploading initial CSV to Drive (link: https://drive.redwood.example/sku-drafts)

marketplace-bot: Note: After artifacts upload, run the checklist command: `./marketplace preflight-check --product redwood-dedicated`.

maria: Thanks team — closing the loop here. We should be ready for the nightly preflight on Friday.
